messages:
maria: Filing follow-up from last night's kv-eviction postmortem. Action list + test plan below. PTAL.

chen: Thanks — adding a load/regression plan makes sense. I can own the test infra.

sam: +1. I'll take the promptset and eval harness for catching prefix-cache regressions.

jordan: Also recommend a chaos drill that kills a GPU mid-batch to validate fallback and graceful degradation. ops-bot, can you schedule a reminder?

ops-bot: Reminder created: 'kv-eviction chaos drill' on 2026-04-10 15:00 UTC. Invitees: maria, chen, sam, jordan.

maria: Proposed deliverables (minimal viable scope):
- regression test in CI reproducing kv-eviction workload — owner: chen — due: 2026-04-03
- promptset (10 targeted prompts + expected outputs) for evals — owner: sam — due: 2026-04-05
- load test profiles (ramp to 10k rps, sustain 90s) + nightly runs on staging — owner: chen — due: 2026-04-07
- chaos drill runbook + dry-run (include rollback steps) — owner: jordan — due: 2026-04-09

chen: Plan: I'll add a locust job and a short JMH microbenchmark for KV eviction path. Will gate on <2% regression in median latency. Posting PR by EOD tomorrow.

sam: For the promptset I'll rework the PM postmortem examples and expand to edge cases (truncation, prefix mismatch, stream reordering). Will add expected outputs and a small grading script in evals repo.

jordan: Runbook items I'll include: canary traffic cutover, metric thresholds (CPU>80% for 30s, error rate spike >0.5%), and quick rollback toggles to disable KV caching.

maria: I'll create a 'postmortem-tests' column on the ops board and add one ticket per deliverable so we can track owners + timelines.

chen: Posting the initial CI PR now, tagging @maria and @sam for review.

sam: Ack — I'll review and start the prompt examples. Adding a negation test to detect false positives.

jordan: One last ask: recurring pattern detection — can we have a nightly job that scans traces for kv-eviction signature and creates incidents when pattern recurs? Owner: platform-observability. @maria can you loop them in?

maria: Looping in @platform-observability — please advise on feasibility and a rough ETA. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
